about: The regression zoo for PLAN-jev.md sites I and J (step 2).
`truth` is what the EVENTUAL FIX decided, not what any rule said at the time and
not an opinion formed here: every `source` names the commit, round or published run
the case came from, and the strings are the ones that appear in the source comment,
the test that pins the fix, or the recording in bench/fixtures/recordings.
Ordinary cases sit beside the named ones on purpose. A zoo of nothing but the
incidents measures recall and cannot see a false alarm, and a triage that flags a
quarter of an ordinary session is not advisory, it is noise.

from  - ValueProvenance: read | typed | url | var | reported
nth   - which occurrence of `value` in `text` (0-based, default 0)
